conviction_note: Abs move set at 8% (option event-implied 6.5% net of a 92% realised-vol tape, last two confirmed prints -5% and -5.3%, and a forward guide that has to address an FY shipment target the Q3 guide leaves steep) with p_up 44: the one substantive lean is that the reiterated FY26 3.0-3.5m shipment guide plus the 800-850k Q3 guide imply a Q4 of at least ~1.08m units (+27% QoQ at the floor, ~+66% at the midpoint) into a China passenger market down 25% y/y in October and a top customer (Li Auto) down 9% y/y, so the Q4/FY guide is the risk; that lean is held near 50 because peers' Q3 lidar volumes were very strong, calls are bid (skew -3.6), and short interest is 7.3 days to cover. The findings sum to -1.7, close to the scaled -0.96; no tension worth flagging.
bar: Q3 2026 net revenue guide RMB1,100-1,150m (US$162-169m), company 6-K 2026-08-18 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001861737/000110465926098050/tm2623467d1_ex99-1.htm ; Q3 shipment guide 800-850k units from the Q2 call transcript https://www.webull.com/news/15463316535657472 ; Q3 revenue consensus ~US$165.1m (≈ guide midpoint) and Q4 consensus US$237.5m from Benzinga, snippet only (page 403), single source https://www.benzinga.com/quote/HSAI/earnings-forecasts . The Q3 bar is company-sourced; the Q4 bar rests on one snippet, so the guidance finding is capped.
positioning_check: Short interest 8,195,754 shares at the 2026-10-15 FINRA settlement, 5.2% of 157.64m shares outstanding (not float), 7.26 days to cover, flat over the last six settlements at 8.1-9.1m; equibles models ~9.2m for 10-30 (estimate, not reported) https://equibles.com/stocks/hsai/shortinterest . Skew_25d -3.64 vol points (calls bid, 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.72. Tape: +16.3% over 5 days off a 52-week low of $11.85 (2026-10-22, MarketBeat), -5.4% over 20 days, -50% from the 52w high. Moderately crowded short (7 DTC) plus call-bid skew argue against sizing a negative large.

findings.finding: Hesai's reiterated FY2026 lidar shipment guide of 3.0-3.5m units (Q2 call, 2026-08-18) less H1 shipments of 1,099,998 (Q1 471,723 + Q2 628,275) and the Q3 guide of 800-850k implies Q4 shipments of 1.08-1.58m, i.e. +27% QoQ at the floor and ~+66% at the midpoint versus the Q3 top end; Benzinga's Q4 revenue consensus of US$237.5m (+44% QoQ vs Q3 consensus US$165.1m) bakes in that ramp, while China passenger retail fell 25% y/y in October (NEV retail -10%), Li Auto (the anchor multi-lidar customer) delivered 29,025 in October vs 31,767 a year earlier, and management on the Q2 call declined to comment on Xiaomi allocation after a competitor was added; a Q4 revenue guide or FY shipment range set below that ramp is the most likely negative this print carries.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 print (2026-11-11 is the analogue a year earlier, dated 2025-11-11): stock fell 5.03% intraday despite strong results and a raised FY guide because the Q4 outlook implied a slowdown (https://www.itiger.com/news/1183445981). Q2 2026 print (2026-08-18): -6.1% midday on a Q3 guide read as weak (https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/hesai-sieht-q3-umsatz-bei-rmb-110115-mrd-aktie-fallt-nach-schwacherer-erwartung). The stock has sold the forward guide on both of the last two confirmed prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus for Q4 (US$237.5m) still carries the steep ramp the FY guide implies; if the market had priced a cut, that Q4 estimate would sit near the Q3 run-rate and skew would be put-bid rather than call-bid (-3.6). The 5-day +16% bounce into the print is not what a market positioned for a guide cut looks like. Against that: the stock is already -50% from its high, so part of a softer 2026 is in the level.
findings.independence: China market: CPCA preliminary October 2026 data, passenger retail -25% y/y, NEV retail -10% (https://cnevpost.com/2026/11/04/china-oct-nev-retail-preliminary-cpca/). Customer: Li Auto October 2026 deliveries 29,025 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001791706/000110465926120858/tm2628723d1_ex99-1.htm). Sector read: CATL's slower Q3 profit growth blamed on slower Chinese car sales hit Hesai -8% on 2026-10-21 (https://www.ibtimes.com.au/hesai-shares-fall-chinese-auto-sector-pressure-1877141). Macro-to-company transmission is a proxy; the company has not confirmed any Q4 softness.

findings.finding: Peers that reported Q3 2026 lidar volumes after Hesai last spoke printed very strong ADAS numbers: RoboSense Q3 total 595.6k units (+220.9% y/y, +53.1% QoQ) with ADAS 450.4k (+200.1% y/y), and Seyond Q3 268.9k (+217% y/y); Li Auto Q3 deliveries of 99,964 landed at the top of its 95-100k guide. Industry lidar demand in Q3 ran well above the car market, which makes Hesai's Q3 at or above the top of its 800-850k unit / RMB1.10-1.15bn guide more likely than not (Hesai's own Q3 needs only +27-35% QoQ vs RoboSense's +53%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Hesai has not been paid for reported-quarter beats: Q3 2025 record results sold -5% (https://www.itiger.com/news/1183445981); Q4 2025 shipments 631k beat the 600k guide and 619k consensus with no reliable positive reaction found (https://longportapp.cn/topics/39486324). The reaction function damps this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Q3 consensus (~US$165.1m) sits at the guide midpoint and has not moved to reflect peers' October disclosures; if it had, consensus would be at or above the top of the range. Caveat in size: RoboSense's ADAS jump is partly share taken from Hesai (its Q3 ADAS 450k is close to Hesai's Q2 ADAS 485,904), so the read-across is net-positive industry volume but not clean.
findings.independence: Seyond Q3 shipments 268.9k +217% y/y (https://www.bbtnews.com.cn/2026/1012/607643.shtml); Li Auto Q3 deliveries 99,964 at top of guide (https://cnevpost.com/2026/10/01/li-auto-sept-2026-deliveries/). Different issuers and documents from RoboSense.

findings.finding: Management said on the Q2 call that Q3 2026 is expected to be the quarter when non-ADAS lidar revenue is close to or above half of total revenue, that robotics and overseas lidar carry higher margins than domestic ADAS, and it kept the FY gross margin outlook at close to 40% after Q2's 40.1% (vs 42.5%) and operating income of only RMB2.2m (vs RMB22.9m); the mix shift gives Q3 gross margin a path to hold or tick up even as ADAS ASPs fall, with the SGI revenue guide already raised to RMB200-300m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin was the stated reason for the -5% on the Q3 2025 print (GM 42.1% vs 47.7%) (https://www.itiger.com/news/1183445981); a margin line that holds has not been tested as a positive.
findings.why_not_priced: Sell-side commentary since August has focused on falling lidar ASPs and price-for-volume (Dolphin Research, https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3946451052592521); a market that had priced the mix shift would not be treating margin as the bear case. Inside what the company guided (~40% FY GM), so sized small.
findings.independence: Same document as finding 1 (Q2 call transcript), different line; Q2 6-K confirms GM 40.1% and lower ASPs (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001861737/000110465926098050/tm2623467d1_ex99-1.htm).

findings.finding: The stock runs into the print up 16.3% in five sessions off a 52-week low of $11.85 (2026-10-22) with no company news found to explain the bounce, and this name has sold its last two confirmed prints (-5.03% Nov 2025, -5.3%/-6.1% Aug 2026); a pre-print rally on a sell-the-print name raises the bar for the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: pre-market rally ahead of the print (+5.77% pre-market, https://www.itiger.com/news/1110421451) then -5.03% on the day (https://www.itiger.com/news/1183445981).
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up is in the sealed baseline (run_up_5d +16.26%), so this is mostly visible; what is not priced is the asymmetry it creates against the reaction function. Shrunk because short interest is 7.26 days to cover (squeeze mechanism) and calls are bid.
findings.independence: Baseline tape (run_up_5d_pct 16.26); short interest from equibles (https://equibles.com/stocks/hsai/shortinterest) cuts the other way.

baseline_tension: The guidance lean is negative while the skew is call-bid (-3.6) and the 5-day run-up is +16%, so it cuts against the option market's lean; it agrees only with the name's habit of selling its prints, which is why p_up sits at 44 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar single-sourced): the Q4 consensus behind finding 1 rests on one Benzinga snippet, and rule 5 (macro-to-company transmission is a proxy) plus rule 7 (sign against a call-bid skew, 7.3 days to cover): guidance finding cut from -2.5 to -2.0.
Rule 1 (this name sells reported-quarter beats): peer read-across finding cut from +0.8 to +0.5.
Rule 7 (crowded-ish short, calls bid): positioning finding cut from -0.8 to -0.5.
'Asking what the market missed generates pessimism' and rule 3: p_up moved from 43 to 44; abs_move_pct left at 8.0; mix/margin finding left standing at +0.3.
